en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5. And from the previous chain from al-Hussain b. Sa’eed from Hamad b. Isa from Hareez from Muhammad b. Muslim who said:

The narrator asked Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) regarding Salaat of Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-e-Qurban. Imam (a.s.) replied, “There is no Azaan or Iqamah for them and there is no Salaat before and after these two rakats.”
